title: 700+ customers in year one: How Blacksmith built scalable usage-based billing for CI/CD with Lago
summary: Company Background Blacksmith (YC W24) entered the market with a mission to build the fastest infrastructure for software development. The company provides high-performance CI/CD services that complement GitHub Actions. By avoiding hyperscalers and running on bare metal infrastructure, Blacksmith delivers faster, more cost-effective and more reliable CI for developers.
